title: Every tsunami on record: where they start, where the water went, and who died
excerpt: I mapped all 1,699 tsunamis in NOAA's Global Historical Tsunami Database since 1610 BC and the places their water reached. 72% started with an earthquake, the highest ran 524 m up a mountainside, and 2004 alone accounts for 42% of recorded deaths.
seo_description: A map of 1,699 tsunamis since 1610 BC: causes, the places the water reached, the deadliest, the highest and the farthest waves.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every tsunami on record' in black and deep blue on pale paper, beside a Pacific-centred world map with orange and red circles for tsunami sources along the plate boundaries, the largest off Sumatra, and blue dots along the coasts their water reached.
